notes: The one-click standard, applied to the installer, to the edge and to the agent itself. Eight defects two real Windows PCs on two real ISPs found: a setup.exe that would not upgrade an existing install, a coordinator peer list that froze at the first hello so every device already connected broke when a new one was added, a relay endpoint given as a name and never resolved so fallback never happened on the real internet, an installer wizard still reachable in production, a panel that showed Offline while devices were heartbeating, and Windows Firewall silently dropping every inbound packet on the overlay. Adds pre-approved join codes so a device can be authorised at enrolment by an admin's explicit choice, deploy/upgrade-edge.sh so the coordinator and relay upgrade in one command, and agent self-update over a signed release so the next fix does not mean visiting every PC.
